summary.text: Catherine Wallen is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 193, which she has represented since April 2026, and is running for a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election. She owns and operates a family farm and has worked in the healthcare industry.

paragraphs.text: Wallen studied at Bermudian Springs High School and HACC, Central Pennsylvania's Community College.
Her career experience includes owning and operating a family farm called Orchard Views LLC, as well as working in the healthcare industry.
She served as a district director in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for the 193rd Legislative District.

She has been affiliated with organizations including Businesswomen of Gettysburg, the Pennsylvania Farm Bureau, the Adams County Farm Bureau, the Anne Anstine Republican Leadership Series and East Berlin VFW Post 8896.
Wallen won the March 17, 2026 special general election for District 193 and assumed office on April 13, 2026, succeeding Torren Ecker.
